market_context: The Nasdaq-100 fell 1.99% to 26,214.17 (QQQ -1.99% to $638.10) as chip stocks reversed Monday's Nvidia-fueled rally; the PHLX Semiconductor Index dropped 7.9%, the Nasdaq Composite lost 1.48% to 23,733.54 and the S&P 500 0.50% to 7,201.09, while the Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.70.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-24 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Analog Devices Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: Analog Devices reported record fiscal fourth-quarter results before the open that beat estimates (adjusted EPS $4.06 vs $3.89 expected, revenue $4.37 billion vs $4.32 billion) but guided first-quarter fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS to $3.82 ± $0.20, which Yahoo Finance said was below Bloomberg consensus; the shares led the S&P 500 lower.
